component.name: ProbeScene
component.script:
sub init() m.clock = CreateObject("roTimespan") m.seq = 0 m.samples = 0 m.lastState = "" m.maxPanels = 4 m.names = ["A", "B", "C", "D"] m.sizes = ["narrow", "wide", "narrow", "wide"] m.colors = ["0x603020FF", "0x206030FF", "0x203060FF", "0x606020FF"] m.ps = m.top.findNode("panelSet") m.steps = [ "key:Right", "key:Right", "key:Left", "key:Left", "key:Right", "key:Right2", "key:Left", "key:Left", "key:Left", "key:Right_Left", "key:Left", "key:Play", "key:Left", "key:Fwd", "key:Left", "dur:1.5", "key:Right", "key:Left", "dur:0", "key:Right", "key:Left", "done" ] m.step = -1 rec("info", "psFields " + fieldList(m.ps, ["slideDuration", "numPanels", "isGoingBack", "slidingStatus", "leftPanelIndex", "goBack"])) rec("info", "psChildren(before) " + childList(m.ps)) m.ps.observeField("isGoingBack", "onPsField") m.ps.observeField("numPanels", "onPsField") if m.ps.hasField("slidingStatus") then m.ps.observeField("slidingStatus", "onPsField") if m.ps.hasField("leftPanelIndex") then m.ps.observeField("leftPanelIndex", "onPsField") m.top.findNode("sampler").observeField("fire", "onSample") m.top.findNode("stepTimer").observeField("fire", "onStep")
m.panelA = makePanel(0) m.ps.appendChild(m.panelA) rec("act", "appended A numPanels=" + StrI(m.ps.numPanels).trim()) m.panelA.setFocus(true) rec("info", "psChildren(after A) " + childList(m.ps)) m.top.findNode("sampler").control = "start" m.top.findNode("stepTimer").control = "start" end sub
function now() as string return StrI(m.clock.TotalMilliseconds()).trim() end function
sub rec(kind as string, body as string) m.seq = m.seq + 1 s = StrI(m.seq).trim() while len(s) < 4 s = "0" + s end while print "PROBE|" + s + "|" + now() + "|" + kind + "|" + body end sub
function num(v as dynamic) as string return Str(Int(v * 10 + 0.5) / 10).trim() end function
function fieldList(node as object, keys as object) as string out = "" for each k in keys if node.hasField(k) v = node.getField(k) out = out + k + "=" + valStr(v) + " " else out = out + k + "=<absent> " end if end for return out end function
function valStr(v as dynamic) as string t = type(v) if t = "roBoolean" or t = "Boolean" if v then return "true" else return "false" else if t = "roInt" or t = "Integer" or t = "roFloat" or t = "Float" or t = "roDouble" or t = "Double" return num(v) else if t = "roArray" out = "[" for each e in v out = out + valStr(e) + "," end for return out + "]" else if t = "roString" or t = "String" return chr(34) + v + chr(34) end if return "<" + t + ">" end function
function childList(node as object) as string out = "" for i = 0 to node.getChildCount() - 1 c = node.getChild(i) out = out + c.subtype() + "#" + c.id + " " end for return "count=" + StrI(node.getChildCount()).trim() + " " + out end function
function makePanel(index as integer) as object p = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ProbePanel") p.id = m.names[index] p.panelSize = m.sizes[index] p.hasNextPanel = index < m.maxPanels - 1 bg = p.findNode("bg") bg.width = p.width bg.color = m.colors[index] p.findNode("name").text = "Panel " + p.id + " (" + p.panelSize + ")" rec("info", "made " + p.id + " " + fieldList(p, ["panelSize", "leftPosition", "width", "height", "translation"])) p.observeField("focusedChild", "onPanelFocus") p.observeField("translation", "onPanelTranslation") p.observeField("isOffscreenLeft", "onPanelField") p.observeField("leftOrientation", "onPanelField") p.observeField("height", "onPanelField") return p end function
' The PanelSet's first children are its two internal arrow Posters, so panels are filtered by type. function panelChildren() as object out = [] for i = 0 to m.ps.getChildCount() - 1 c = m.ps.getChild(i) if c.hasField("leftPosition") then out.push(c) end for return out end function
function lastPanel() as object panels = panelChildren() if panels.count() = 0 then return invalid return panels[panels.count() - 1] end function
sub onPanelFocus(ev as object) p = ev.getRoSGNode() if p.hasFocus() rec("focus", p.id + " hasFocus numPanels=" + StrI(m.ps.numPanels).trim()) else if p.isInFocusChain() rec("focus", p.id + " inChain child=" + p.focusedChild.id) else rec("focus", p.id + " lost") return end if ' Typical app pattern: focusing the last panel creates and appends the next one. last = lastPanel() count = panelChildren().count() if last <> invalid and last.isSameNode(p) and count < m.maxPanels and p.id <> "F" nextIndex = count nxt = makePanel(nextIndex) m.ps.appendChild(nxt) rec("act", "appended " + nxt.id + " numPanels=" + StrI(m.ps.numPanels).trim() + " isGoingBack=" + valStr(m.ps.isGoingBack)) end if end sub
sub onPanelTranslation(ev as object) p = ev.getRoSGNode() tr = ev.getData() rec("tr", p.id + " " + num(tr[0]) + "," + num(tr[1])) end sub
sub onPanelField(ev as object) rec("pf", ev.getRoSGNode().id + "." + ev.getField() + "=" + valStr(ev.getData())) end sub
sub onPsField(ev as object) rec("ps", ev.getField() + "=" + valStr(ev.getData())) end sub
sub onSample() m.samples = m.samples + 1 state = "" for i = 0 to m.ps.getChildCount() - 1 c = m.ps.getChild(i) if c.hasField("leftPosition") r = c.boundingRect() state = state + c.id + "@" + num(c.translation[0]) + "/br" + num(r.x) + "w" + num(r.width) + " " else state = state + c.subtype() + "@" + num(c.translation[0]) + "v" + valStr(c.visible) + "o" + num(c.opacity) + " " end if end for if state <> m.lastState m.lastState = state rec("frame", "n=" + StrI(m.samples).trim() + " " + state) end if end sub
sub onStep() m.step = m.step + 1 action = m.steps[m.step] rec("step", StrI(m.step).trim() + " " + action + " psChildren " + childList(m.ps) + " " + fieldList(m.ps, ["slideDuration", "numPanels", "isGoingBack"])) if action = "done" rec("info", "samples=" + StrI(m.samples).trim()) print "PROBE|done" m.top.probeExit = true return end if parts = action.split(":") if parts[0] = "key" print "PROBE|await|" + parts[1] else if parts[0] = "dur" m.ps.slideDuration = parts[1].toFloat() rec("act", "slideDuration=" + valStr(m.ps.slideDuration)) ' No key to wait for: advance immediately. m.top.findNode("stepTimer").duration = 0.1 end if if parts[0] = "key" m.top.findNode("stepTimer").duration = 3 end if m.top.findNode("stepTimer").control = "start" end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean rec("key", "scene " + key + " press=" + valStr(press)) if not press then return false if key = "play" f = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ProbePanel") f.id = "F" f.panelSize = "full" f.isFullScreen = true f.hasNextPanel = false f.findNode("bg").width = f.width f.findNode("name").text = "Panel F (full)" rec("info", "made F " + fieldList(f, ["panelSize", "leftPosition", "width", "height", "translation"])) f.observeField("focusedChild", "onPanelFocus") f.observeField("translation", "onPanelTranslation") f.observeField("isOffscreenLeft", "onPanelField") m.ps.appendChild(f) rec("act", "appended F numPanels=" + StrI(m.ps.numPanels).trim()) f.setFocus(true) return true else if key = "fastforward" b2 = makePanel(1) b2.id = "B2" old = m.ps.getChild(1) m.ps.replaceChild(b2, 1) rec("act", "replaced " + old.id + " with B2 numPanels=" + StrI(m.ps.numPanels).trim()) return true end if return false end function
